layout_strategies.navbar: Sticky top-0 z-50 bg-white/85 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200/80 px-4 sm:px-8 py-3.5 flex items-center justify-between

landing_page.hero: Bold title 'Trendyol, CV ve Sosyal Medya İçeriklerinizi AI ile Saniyeler İçinde Oluşturun', live badge 5 Ücretsiz Kredi, interactive listing generator preview with real-time output text stream effect.
landing_page.tools_overview: 3 main categories showcase: 🛒 E-Ticaret Ürün İlanı (Trendyol, Hepsiburada, n11, Amazon), 📄 Profesyonel CV & Niyet Mektubu, 📲 7 Günlük Sosyal Medya İçerik Planı.
landing_page.live_examples: Interactive tabs showing real before/after Turkish content generated by Kazandıran.
landing_page.pricing: 3 Credit Packs: 5 Free Credits (Deneme), 50 Credits (99 TL), 200 Credits (299 TL - Popüler), 600 Credits (699 TL - Ajans). Stripe integrated feel.
landing_page.faq: Accordion listing key questions (Krediler nasıl düşer?, Trendyol algoritmasına uygun mu?, İade poliçesi nedir?).

dashboard.credit_banner: Displays current available credits (e.g. 5 / 5 Kredi), Quick Buy button, usage stats.
dashboard.tool_cards: Bento style big actionable cards with icon, description, badge (1 Kredi harcar), CTA button 'Hemen Oluştur'.
dashboard.history_section: Recent generation history table/list with filter by tool type, date, quick copy and open in panel.

tool_workspaces.ecommerce_tool: Form: Platform selector (Trendyol, Hepsiburada, n11, Amazon, Etsy), Ürün Adı, Marka, Özellikler/Meteryal, Hedef Kitle, Ton (Satış Odaklı, Samimi, Lüks, Teknik). Output: SEO başlığı, Madde madde özellikler, İkna edici ürün açıklaması, Anahtar kelime etiketleri.
tool_workspaces.cv_tool: Form: Pozisyon / Meslek, Deneyim Seviyesi, Yetenekler / Eğitim, Başvurulan Şirket / Sektör. Output: Özelleştirilmiş Niyet Mektubu (Cover Letter) + Güçlü CV Özet & Başarı Maddeleri.
tool_workspaces.social_tool: Form: Konu / Ürün, Platform (Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube), Hedef (Etkileşim, Satış, Marka Bilinirliği), Gün Sayısı (1 veya 7 Günlük Plan). Output: Gün gün Post başlığı, Visual/Reels fikri, Metin taslağı, Hashtag seti.

output_panel.design: Clean paper document visual with subtle lines or clean background, action bar on top (Copy text button, Download TXT/PDF button, Regenerate button, Word counter, Credit status badge).
output_panel.animation: Typing streaming simulation effect when user triggers content generation.

testing_and_data_attrs.rule: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard JS / JSX files as configured in the project.
Import Lucide icons for UI icons (ShoppingBag, FileText, Share2, Sparkles, Copy, Download, Check, RefreshCw, Zap, ShieldCheck, HelpCircle).
Ensure the Turkish text is clear, professional, natural, and accurately formatted (e.g. Trendyol, Hepsiburada, n11, Kredi).
Implement Sonner toast notifications when users copy text, run out of credits, or purchase credit packs.
Keep credit counter updated in local state or React Context so when a generation finishes, credits decrement by 1.
Ensure responsive design from mobile (1 column, sticky bottom CTA) to desktop (2-column workspace).
